description: Fork of exp588 (1.4344 SoTA, dense single read_out_lut H=1 NAP=6 tph=1536 -> D=384). SINGLE change: readout_input_nap 6 -> 4. Drops rows-per-table from K=64 to K=16. Atom count 98K -> 24K (4x less). Routing entropy per token 9216 -> 6144 bits. CRITICAL: mixture depth (=tph) UNCHANGED at 1536, atom width UNCHANGED at 384, per-token bandwidth UNCHANGED at 18.87 Mbits. Only weight storage shrinks (37.7M -> 9.43M, -28.3M). Disambiguates atom-count vs mixture-depth axes: exp588 (98K, 1536), exp591 (32K, 512), exp590/589 (98K, 256), exp592 (24K, 1536). If exp592 ~= exp588: atoms are slack, depth dominates. If exp592 ~= exp591: atom count drives loss. If exp592 < exp591: NAP=4's faster row-coverage at bs=16 helps (exp390 echo). Total ~251.7M params, ~155 Mbits trunk (unchanged from exp588), ~558 Mbits total.
